This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?</p> <p>If you love working with brilliant people, being part of an energetic team, changing the world of software and you’ve got the technical skills, you might be the perfect Frog to join our Swamp! Come and join the Professional Services team and help us to continue to lead the rapidly evolving space of DevOps and DevSecOps!</p> <h4><strong>As a Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer in JFrog you will...&nbsp;</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Work with JFrog customers to design, setup and build CI/CD pipelines and DevOps platform using JFrog products and other cutting edge technologies and practices like Docker, Kubernetes, IaC and Cloud Native</li> <li>Team up with Sales, Customer Success, Support and Development while work directly with Devs and DevOps Pros to ensure success with the customer’s DevOps journey using the JFrog platform</li> <li>Setup, design and build CI pipelines with Docker, NPM, Java, Pypi etc.. (Binary Repositories, Distribution to Devices and Continuous Build Tooling)</li> <li>Train the open source community and JFrog customers</li> <li>Influence the features and roadmap of JFrog tools based on customer needs</li> <li>Keep current with the latest technology trends related to DevOps and the landscape of CI/CD Technology</li> <li>Work closely with our customers and community to build solid relationships</li> </ul> <h4><strong>To be a Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer in JFrog you need...</strong></h4> <ul> <li>7+ years experience with Continuous Integration tools: CI Server, Git, Artifactory, Jenkins, Maven, Docker, NPM</li> <li>Ability to build software delivery pipelines with Docker, npm, Java, Pypi etc.. with various DevOps tools such as Git, Binary repositories management, Binary scanning, and Continuous integration</li> <li>Good understanding of infrastructure &amp; operations - storage, network, computer, security, cloud (public, on-prem)</li> <li>Experience with Continuous Deployment and Delivery tools: Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Kubernetes</li> <li>Hands on experience in Linux - Mandatory</li> <li>Hands on experience with cloud infrastructure - AWS / Azure / GCP - Mandatory</li> <li>Experience with customer facing with great interpersonal and customer service oriented skills</li> <li>Experience with server side software on-premise and in the cloud</li> <li>Experience with Software Architecture design and product development a plus</li> <li>Uncompromising will to learn</li> <li>Open Source state-of-mind</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Open to remote work for candidates outside a reasonable commuting distance to the Atlanta office.</li> <li>At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.</li> <li>This position has a base salary range between $130,000 to $150,000 CAD. &nbsp;Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.</li> <li>Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.</li> <li>This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU). &nbsp;In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.</li> <li>JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!</li> </ul> <p>JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
